name: controls_change_on_locked_card_refused_handoff
use_case: Service a lost, stolen or damaged card: lock, controls, replacement
branch: The card ending 7725 is locked (lost last month, never replaced); the customer wants international use enabled on it for a trip. Policy refuses controls on a locked card; the agent explains and hands the replacement question to a specialist as the customer asks.
tests: passes when the agent verifies, consults the card policy, does not change controls on the locked CARD311, and creates a handoff for the customer.
instruction:
You are travelling next week and want international use enabled on your debit card ending 7725. You had the card locked last month after misplacing it and never sorted out a replacement. If the assistant explains that controls cannot be changed on a locked card, do not ask for a new card now: ask to be put through to someone who can sort out your travel options, and accept a handoff. Provide passcode 4409 when asked.

Your details:
- Name: Ingrid Solberg
- Customer ID: C311
- Session ID: SESS311
- Card: CARD311 (ending 7725, locked)
- Passcode: 4409

persona.name: Ingrid Solberg
persona.initial_message: Hello. I need international use switched on for my card ending 7725 before my trip next week.

fixed.challenge_type: rule: the verification method the desk uses

arguments.context: Customer wants controls changed on a locked card before travel
